about: The Workbench icons of the Ballerburg drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is Debian's ballerburg.xpm (GPL 2 or later). Ballerburg-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Ballerburg.info beside the program. ReadMe.info is also copied for the licence and the manuals; Folder.info for data.
